tbesh_html:
1) to diminish, restrain, withdraw, abate, keep back, do away, take from, clip
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to diminish
1a2) to restrain
1a3) to withdraw
1b) (Niphal)
1b1) to be withdrawn
1b2) to be restrained
1c) (Piel) to withdraw, draw up

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to scrape off; by implication, to shave, remove, lessen, withhold
strongs_1890.kjv_def: abate, clip, (di-) minish, do (take) away, keep back, restrain, make small, withdraw.
